322c9d922994.headline: AAA on FOX Results: La Catalina Appears, Wagner Brothers Defend Tag Titles
322c9d922994.summary: Lucha Libre AAA aired its latest AAA on FOX episode on October 17 on Fox Latin America and YouTube. Reigning AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina appeared on the show, and the Wagner Brothers defended the AAA World Tag Team Championship. Full results are in Fightful's results section.
322c9d922994.reason: AI rewrite said 'Debuts' / 'in-ring debut appearance'; the source (Fightful) only says she appears; the tag title bout was the Wagner Brothers

8dfd5d2e0ec6.headline: Sting's Son Steve Borden Returns, Issues Blood & Guts Challenge On Dynamite
8dfd5d2e0ec6.summary: Steve Borden, the son of Sting, returned on AEW Dynamite alongside Darby Allin to save Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland from a Don Callis Family beatdown after their tag team loss to Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight. Borden, out since being injured at All Out, then took the microphone and challenged the Don Callis Family to Blood & Guts, set for the November 4 Dynamite. The Young Bucks also helped clear the ring.

ceb7023fb264.headline: Penta Reveals How His Family Helped Him Choose WWE Over AEW
ceb7023fb264.summary: Speaking on Busted Open Radio, Penta looked back on his 2024 decision between staying with AEW and signing with WWE. He said he asked his wife and daughters, and they answered "WWE" right away, so he told his agent to make the move. Penta debuted in WWE in January 2025 and today holds the Men's Money in the Bank contract.
ceb7023fb264.reason: 2026-10-22: AI rewrite inverted the fact ('Penta Chose AEW Over WWE'); source (Wrestling Inc, 2026-10-22 21:09 UTC, Busted Open interview) says he chose WWE in 2024. Look-back framing, WWE primary tag.

450b79bb1ad5.headline: WWE Notes: Eric Bischoff Documentary, Hawaii Tryout Vlog And More
450b79bb1ad5.summary: A full documentary on Eric Bischoff has been released, focusing on his career as one of sports-entertainment's most controversial figures. WWE also posted a vlog from a Hawaii tryout featuring The Usos and Liv Morgan coaching prospects, and looked back at a 2021 SmackDown segment with Brock Lesnar and Roman Reigns. Elsewhere, singer Cyndi Lauper, part of WWE's 1980s Rock 'n' Wrestling era, announced a 2027 residency at The Colosseum at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas.
450b79bb1ad5.reason: PWInsider WWE notes roundup; the AI rewrite led with the non-wrestling Cyndi Lauper residency item ('Cyndi Lauper Announces Las Vegas Residency') and the card got a Penta photo. Lead with the wrestling items.

9247a706c222.headline: Street Fight and Two Tag Matches Booked for SmackDown
9247a706c222.summary: Giulia faces Blake Monroe in a Street Fight on the October 23 episode of WWE SmackDown in Ontario, California. New WWE Women's Tag Team Champions Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley defend the titles against Michin and B-Fab, and WWE Tag Team Champions The MFTs (Tama Tonga and Talla Tonga) meet Bakusai (Shinsuke Nakamura and Kyoki) in a non-title match.

03eb17663430.headline: Nikki Bella vs Chelsea Green Title Match Set For Oct. 30 SmackDown
03eb17663430.summary: Nikki Bella will challenge Chelsea Green for the WWE Women's Championship on the October 30 episode of SmackDown at the Charleston Coliseum in West Virginia. Green offered the match for October 23, but Nikki asked for the following week instead. Green first defends the title against Roxanne Perez on the October 23 SmackDown.
